sombrero.title: Sombrero
sombrero.note: The widest hat here at 22 blocks of brim. It will pass through chestplates, elytra and anything else on the shoulders. Nothing can be done about that from a head bone.

hijab.title: Hijab
hijab.note: Reaches the shoulders, so it passes through a chestplate, an elytra and a cape. Nothing can be done about that from a head bone.

shtreimel.title: Shtreimel
shtreimel.note: Wider than the shoulders. Expect it to pass through a chestplate and an elytra.

black_fedora.title: Black Fedora
black_fedora.note: Fourteen of flat brim, so it clips like the other wide ones.

keffiyeh.title: Keffiyeh
keffiyeh.note: Falls to the shoulders, so it passes through a chestplate and an elytra.

nun_veil.title: Nun's Veil
nun_veil.note: The veil reaches the shoulders and will pass through a chestplate, an elytra and a cape.

douli.title: Conical Straw Hat
douli.note: Fifteen across - one of the widest in the set. Expect it to pass through a chestplate and an elytra.

china_hat.title: China Hat
china_hat.note: Nineteen across - the widest in the set. Expect it to pass through a chestplate and an elytra. Solid, not see-through: the standalone module it replaces was translucent and recolourable, which a textured hat is not.

halo.title: Halo
halo.note: Floats clear of the head and is drawn emissive, so it keeps its own brightness in a dark cave.
